original.statement: The storage version of policyexceptions.kyverno.io changes from v2beta1 to v2; existing objects stored as v2beta1 must be migrated by running a storage version migration before v2beta1 is removed.

decision.reason: [ev-f0f21b325fa6] shows that between 1.12.6 and 1.13.0, spec.versions[name=v2beta1].storage on policyexceptions.kyverno.io changed from true to false, and [ev-094d5d8b0291] shows v2 changed from false to true. A validator confirmed that kyverno.io/v2beta1 PolicyException is still served in both releases and that computed change chg-3f9048253803 names this gvk, so the version is neither removed nor marked deprecated. The version keeps working but is no longer the one used for storage, so the evidence best fits behavior-changed on this gvk. The upgrade text treats the storage migration as something to do before a later release removes v2beta1, not as a step this release forces. Confidence is low because no validator could decide the change type.
